items.title: Mozambique seeks private investor for vehicle assembly plant, invites expressions of interest
items.summary: The automotive industry project aims to create skilled jobs and develop industrial competences. The Mozambican Government today set in motion the process of selecting a private investor to install and operate a vehicle assembly plant under a public-private partnership, initially providing for the production of buses and later expanding to other types of vehicles.
